Turn insights into acquisition experiments that scale

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

Description

Are you motivated by helping build structure, processes and culture in a small organization in the start-up phase? Do you have a clear picture of your preferred workplace and a strong experience, feeling and knowledge on how to create such a workplace? And are attracted by a strong purpose in an organization? Then you might be our new People & Operations Manager.

About us

NIVI Development (NIVI-D) is a mission-driven small company that brings together researchers, developers, and strategic partners to move innovative vaccine concepts into clinical development. As part of the Novo Nordisk Foundation Initiative for Vaccines and Immunity (NIVI), we operate within a uniquely integrated ecosystem that connects academic discovery with vaccine development. Working closely with the academic Research centre (NIVI-R), we translate new scientific insights into vaccine candidates that support NIVI’s vision of preventing airborne epidemics. As NIVI-D, our mission is to advance their development toward clinical impact.

The role

As our People & Operations Manager, you will play a key role in supporting NIVI Development’s continued growth. The role combines responsibility for employee-related activities with ownership of operational processes and day-to-day organizational support. Working across a broad range of areas, you will help ensure that the organization remains well-structured, effective and able to support the organization’s evolving needs.

Key responsibilities

• Lead recruitment processes from job posting to onboarding in collaboration with hiring managers.

• Maintain and further develop processes and practices across the employee lifecycle.

• Maintain and update the employee handbook and related policies and guidelines.

• Identify and implement new employee-related initiatives and processes as organizational needs evolve.

• Assist with yearly budgeting and budget follow-up.

• Maintain and further develop the operational practices and processes that support the day-to-day running of the organization.

• Manage and coordinate activities with external service providers and support functions

• Provide ad hoc support to the CEO and employees in NIVI-D e.g. relating to travel, meetings.

About you

You enjoy working across a broad range of responsibilities and are motivated by the opportunity to help a growing organization develop and succeed. You are comfortable balancing recruitment and other employee-related initiatives with practical operational support and thrive in an environment where priorities shift and new needs arise.

You are pragmatic, adaptable and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently. You enjoy creating structure, improving ways of working and taking responsibility for both planned initiatives and the unexpected tasks.

Qualifications

• A relevant educational background within HR, business administration, organizational development or a related field.

• Significant experience from a People Operations, HR, Talent Acquisition, Operations or similar role.

• Hands-on experience with recruitment and onboarding.

• Experience with employee-related processes and organizational development.

• Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.

• A pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset and a great ‘liaison’ with the rest of the employees within NIVI.

• Excellent English communication skills.

We offer

Joining NIVI Development offers a unique opportunity to play a central role in a small and growing organization working to advance innovative vaccine development.

You will take on broad responsibilities across people and operations and have the opportunity to influence how we work, grow and develop as an organization. Working as part of a small and engaged team, you will have a visible impact on how the organization operates and develops.

As an evolving organization, we offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment with significant responsibility, flexibility and room for professional growth.

Our employment package includes pension and health benefits, generous vacation time, and the many advantages of living and working in Copenhagen.

Apply now

Please send your motivated application and CV by clicking “Apply now.” Applications will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible and no later than 27 October 2026.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Clinical Sciences, you'll help turn Hemab's science into well-designed clinical studies and clear evidence about how our treatments perform in patients. You'll take scientific ownership across protocol development, study execution and data interpretation, working closely with Medical Directors and colleagues across clinical development, regulatory and other functions.

What you'll do

• Lead the clinical science contribution to study strategy, design and execution, keeping the scientific questions and patient needs at the centre of decisions.

• Drive protocol development with the Medical Director, including amendments as emerging data or study needs require.

• Own the scientific review of clinical study data, identify discrepancies and trends, and turn emerging safety and efficacy data into clear questions and actions for the team.

• Shape study documents and plans, including informed consent forms, eCRFs, medical monitoring plans and data review plans.

• Guide sites and vendors on protocol requirements, eligibility criteria and participant management so studies are executed consistently and to the intended design.

• Partner across clinical development to analyse and interpret study results and build a clear understanding of what the data mean.

• Translate study findings for internal and external audiences alongside the Medical Director.

• Develop clinical content for regulatory documents, including investigator brochures, annual safety reports, clinical study reports and registration submissions.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Substantial clinical science or clinical research experience in drug development, with direct responsibility for clinical studies.

• Experience developing clinical protocols and interpreting safety and efficacy data from interventional studies.

• A strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical study design and drug development in a regulated environment.

• The scientific judgement to interpret clinical information, literature and changing treatment approaches and apply it to study and development decisions.

• Experience working effectively with investigators, vendors and cross-functional clinical, medical and regulatory colleagues.

Nice to have

• Experience in haematology, rare disease or bleeding disorders.

• Experience contributing to development programmes through later-stage studies and registration.

• An advanced scientific or clinical degree.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Location: Cambridge, MA, USA (for the right candidate, we can consider remote East Coast) or Copenhagen, Denmark

Reporting to: VP, Regulatory Affairs & Quality

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. Our pipeline spans more than one mechanism and modality, because the patients we're built for don't all fit the same one.

We're a patient-first, science-led, clinical-stage company - we went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Regulatory Affairs, you'll shape and deliver global regulatory strategy for Hemab's development programs in rare bleeding disorders. You'll sit close to the science and the development teams, turning complex data and regulatory requirements into clear choices that help our programs move forward.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll own regulatory strategy and agency interactions for your programs, anticipate risk early, and help build the regulatory frameworks Hemab needs as our pipeline and company grow.

What you'll do

• Develop and own global regulatory strategies for one or more development programs, from clinical development through marketing authorization.

• Lead regulatory interactions with health authorities, including meeting strategy, briefing materials, preparation and follow-through.

• Take accountability for high-quality regulatory submissions and approvals, working with Hemab colleagues and external partners to deliver against agreed timelines.

• Translate scientific, clinical and CMC data into clear regulatory positions and practical development choices.

• Identify regulatory risks early, assess the available options and drive mitigation plans with project teams.

• Partner across clinical, CMC, nonclinical, medical and other functions so regulatory strategy is built into development decisions rather than added later.

• Lead external regulatory vendors with clear ownership of quality, timelines and deliverables.

• Track changes in regulatory science and requirements that matter to Hemab's programs, and turn them into action where needed.

What you'll bring to Hemab

Essential

• Significant regulatory affairs experience (ideally in small molecules) with direct responsibility for global development programs and regulatory strategy.

• Experience leading health authority interactions and major regulatory submissions for biologic and/or other innovative medicines.

• Strong working knowledge of global drug development requirements and the ability to interpret regulatory guidance in the context of scientific and clinical data.

• Evidence that you've anticipated and solved complex regulatory issues, including developing credible options when the path isn't obvious.

• The ability to write and review high-quality regulatory content yourself, while also leading work delivered through colleagues and external partners.

• Experience working across functions and geographies, with the judgement to challenge, influence and reach decisions without slowing the team down.

Nice to have

• Rare disease, hematology or coagulation experience.

• Experience in a clinical-stage biotech where regulatory frameworks and ways of working are still being built.

• Experience with emerging regulatory requirements

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems get created as we need them, rather than handed down in advance. In this role, you'll help create some of the regulatory frameworks you work within. We also work across two hubs and multiple time zones, so making those relationships work takes deliberate effort.

You'll fit well here if you take ownership when you hit the first wall, ask for help when you need it, and don't carry much ego about where the answer comes from. For a company our size, how you work matters as much as pedigree. Good structure should help people move faster and trust each other, not create extra layers.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

In this role, you will join the growth team in building best-in-class experiences that drive product-led growth. If you are excited about driving innovation, eager to take ownership of significant projects, and keen on making a global impact, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Join Trustpilot's Product Management team and play an integral part in shaping the future of our dynamic and rapidly growing organization. Together, let's push the boundaries of what's possible in the Product space and create a lasting impact on our customers worldwide.

What you’ll be doing:

• Leading a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality experiences that lead to desired outcomes

• Build out PLG strategy in partnership with Product, Monetisation, Marketing and Commercial teams

• Collaborating with your team and others to think big and imagine future solutions to solve problems

• Run experiments to increase targeted outcomes and share those learnings across the company

• Partner with analytics and research to better understand what drives your targeted outcomes; be a subject matter expert on the topic

• Contribute to the continuous development of our overarching growth product strategy

• Taking ownership of the product roadmap and backlog, and ensuring that they are aligned with business goals and customer needs

• Conducting research and interacting regularly with customers to gain knowledge about the problems you are solving and defining and framing these problems with your team

• Building relationships with stakeholders in sales, marketing, and customer success and promoting product-thinking throughout the organisation

• Communicating product plans, status, and issues to internal stakeholders and executive leadership

• Motivating your team and colleagues to produce their best work possible.

Who you are:

• Proven history of delivering tangible business outcomes

• Good communication skills and proven history of effective collaboration with cross-functional product teams

• Passion for delivering high-quality experiences that solve customer problems and drive business impact

• Comprehensive understanding of product management principles and processes, including product strategy, product roadmap development, and agile development methodologies

• Analytical mindset and can leverage data to inform your product decisions as well as establish metrics and OKRs to measure product success

• Friendly, knowledgeable, open-minded, collaborative and able to motivate and inspire others.

• Experience in B2B or SaaS products is desirable

• Experience working on a Growth team is desirable

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

We need an experienced and skilled Senior Product Manager to lead one of our key product areas. Working in a cross-functional product squad, you will drive innovation and product evolution in a world where the technologies consumers are using to make decisions are changing faster than ever before by defining new, ambiguous problem spaces.

If you are passionate about driving innovation, eager to take ownership of significant projects, and keen on making a global impact, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for. Join Trustpilot's Product Management team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic and rapidly growing organization. Together, let's push the boundaries of what's possible in the Product space and create a lasting impact on our users worldwide.

What you'll be doing:

• Lead cross-functional agile teams, including remote members, through the entire product lifecycle for complex products

• Take ownership of long-term product discovery, strategic roadmaps, and execution while aligning them with business goals and customer needs

• Collaborate with designers, engineers, data scientists, and other key senior stakeholders to develop new features and optimize existing products

• Prioritize new features and enhancements using robust product management frameworks

• Conduct in-depth user research and leverage data insights to identify ambiguous, strategic opportunities and define new product visions

• Drive decision-making by setting clear priorities and using data (quantitative and qualitative) to measure success

• Communicate product strategy, status updates, and potential risks to executive leadership and internal teams, ensuring strategic alignment across the business

• Cultivate solid connections between the sales, marketing, and customer service departments to proactively lead change and promote product-focused mindsets across the organisation

• Inspire and motivate teams to achieve their best performance, establishing a culture of high collaboration and innovation, and mentoring more junior Product Managers

Who you are:

• Significant product management experience working within agile teams, with a proven history of driving significant business impact and delivering effective products

• Comprehensive understanding of product management principles, including setting long-term product strategy, owning roadmap development, and agile methodologies

• Demonstrated experience working in cross-functional teams and successfully influencing senior leadership and executive stakeholders, without direct authority

• Expertise in user research, A/B testing, and data analysis to independently define strategic direction and product development

• Skilled in critical assessment and oversight, with expertise in defining, setting up, and supervising key performance indicators and measures of achievement

• Passion for emerging technologies and their potential to transform the product area and user experience

• Great communication and executive-level stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse teams around a common, long-term vision

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Pension and life insurance

• Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan

• Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme

• Central office location complete with pop up events organised by our own community team as well as the building’s community team

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more.

Still not sure?

We're looking for senior consultants to take a leading role in complex ERP transformation projects across ERP strategy, programme management, solution architecture, and functional consulting.

What you’ll do

You will take a leading role in some of the largest ERP transformations across Europe. Depending on your profile and development goals, your responsibilities may include:

· Shaping ERP strategies and road maps, system and vendor selections, enterprise solution architecture, and scope definition and value cases, including RISE with SAP and Clean Core positioning

· Programme design, mobilisation and planning, programme and project management, PMO setup and operation, and independent programme assurance, using SAP Activate, Success by Design, or similar as well as Implement’s Half Double methodology

· Business process mapping and design, process optimisation, fit-gap analysis and requirements gathering, facilitation of key design decisions (KDDs), and test design and execution support

· Data migration and transformation (ETL), data cleansing and quality assurance, data governance and operating models, and platform data model design – including MDM concepts and cutover planning

· Advising CxO-level stakeholders, facilitating decision forums and steering committees, and coaching less experienced colleagues

Our projects typically combine process design, solution architecture, complex stakeholder management, and change management. As a senior consultant, you will often be the one holding the pen on the overall design and the client relationship. AI is part of our daily life at Implement. We use it actively in how we analyse, design, build, and deliver, and you’ll be expected to embrace it as a natural part of your consulting toolkit.

What you'll bring

Ideally, you have 5+ years of experience from ERP consulting, including participation in at least one full-cycle implementation (SAP S/4HANA/ECC or Microsoft D365 F&O). In addition, we'd prefer candidates who:

· Bring deep functional and process expertise, especially within SAP S/4HANA, in one or more areas such as finance and controlling (FI/CO, Margin Analysis), order to cash (SD), procure to pay (MM/Ariba), plan to fulfil (DM/PP/QM), warehousing and logistics (EWM/TM), or master data management – or bring strong Microsoft D365 F&O expertise (finance, supply chain, or architecture) and the ambition to further develop this area

· Have experience leading programmes, projects, or PMOs, or acting as enterprise/solution architect, in complex ERP transformations

· Are a strong communicator who can structure and facilitate presentations and workshops in English – German or a Scandinavian language is an additional advantage

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy, working side by side with some of the strongest ERP transformation profiles in the Nordics – and, on platform-heavy delivery, with our technological sister company, The Tech Collective.

We're a practice with one of the strongest growth journeys at Implement, built on a unique culture, helpful colleagues, and a shared ambition to do consulting differently. With us, you'll have plenty of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, through internal training, certifications, keynotes, and workshops, along with the freedom to shape your own career and choose your own leaders.

The position is based at our office in Hellerup, with flexibility and occasional travel to clients across the Nordics and Europe. The starting date is flexible for the right candidates.

The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning (m/f/d) – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
Job description

We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note that for the first year, you’ll be employed in our Copenhagen office, Implement’s HQ, before joining the Zurich office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

• International mindset: You’re excited to live a year in Copenhagen to immerse yourself in our strong Implement culture while working in an international team and to build a broad network at Implement (speaking Danish is not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• Hands-on from day one: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• High-trust culture: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• International environment: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

• An exciting start to your career: Feel the energy and atmosphere at our Copenhagen HQ for one year, joining a cohort of international graduates. Build a community and engage in a steep learning programme into the world of supply chain planning before you move on to the Zurich office.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is September or October 2027 in Copenhagen.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with over 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

Join our Chipset team and help bring the next generation of hearing technology to life

Are you passionate about electronics and practical problem-solving? Do you enjoy working hands-on with hardware, supporting users, and helping turn ideas into working solutions? If so, we encourage you to apply.

At Demant, we develop state-of-the-art chipsets that power our hearing healthcare products used by millions of people worldwide. We are looking for a Junior Chipset Engineer to support our development teams by maintaining and troubleshooting chipset platforms, supporting internal users, and contributing to the development of new chipset test solutions.

Welcome to Chipset

Chipset is a key division within our Research & Development organization. We design and develop advanced integrated circuits and chipset platforms that power our world-leading hearing instruments and accessories.

Our commitment to technological excellence drives us to deliver professional-grade solutions in DSP processing, audio quality, connectivity, AI integration, and rechargeability, all in compact form factors with extremely low power consumption.

You will become part of a team of highly skilled engineers working across analog IC design, digital IC design, verification, test development, and system integration. Together, we create the technologies used in products from Oticon, Philips, Bernafon, and other leading hearing healthcare brands.

The Role

As a Junior Chipset Engineer, you will play an important role in both supporting our chipset development activities and contributing to the development of the next generation of chipset test platforms.

You will act as a key point of contact for internal users of our chipset development platforms while also participating in hardware development activities under the guidance of experienced engineers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide support for chipset hardware platforms and development boards.

• Prepare, maintain, and improve chipset boards and lab setups.

• Assist with schematic design and PCB layout of test boards.

• Contribute to the development of chipset test systems.

• Bring up, test, debug, new hardware designs.

• Perform soldering and rework of prototype hardware.

• Document solutions, procedures, and designs in compliance with quality requirements.

• Collaborate with verification teams, as well as external suppliers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to chipset development, from practical laboratory work and user support to hardware design and test system development.

About You

You may have a background as an Electronics Technician, Laboratory Technician, Electrical Engineering Technician, or a recently graduated Electronics Engineer.

We imagine that you have:

• a solid understanding of electronics and electronic measurement techniques

• hands-on experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers

• an interest in hardware development, troubleshooting, and practical problem solving

• good documentation and communication skills

• a structured and service-minded approach to your work

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

• schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Cadence or OrCAD

• prototype hardware debugging and bring-up

• soldering and rework of electronic assemblies

• automated test systems

• scripting or automation using Python

• Quality Management Systems (QMS)

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

• enjoys combining practical hands-on work with engineering activities

• likes helping colleagues solve technical challenges

• is curious and eager to develop new technical skills

• can communicate effectively with engineers and stakeholders across multiple disciplines

• takes ownership of tasks and follows them through to completion

• thrives in a collaborative team environment  #LI-CC1  #LI-HYBRID

Why Join Us?

At Demant, you will become part of a world-class technology organization developing products that improve the lives of millions of people with hearing loss.

We offer:

• a friendly and highly collaborative engineering environment

• access to advanced development laboratories and state-of-the-art technology

• opportunities to learn from experts across ASIC design, firmware, verification, and system development

• a thorough onboarding process and mentoring from experienced colleagues

• flexibility, professional development, and excellent employee benefits

Most importantly, you will play a central role in supporting the teams that create the technology behind some of the world's most advanced hearing solutions.

Do You Want to Join the Team?

Then please send your CV and application letter as soon as possible and no later than Sunday, October 25, 2026.

For any questions, please contact Peter Siegumfeldt, Senior Manager Chipset, at psie@demant.com.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

Your impact begins here

From due diligence and valuation to finance integration of R&D acquisitions, you will give the CFO, Executive Management and the Deal Group clear, decision-ready insight. Your work helps Novo act on strategic opportunities with clarity and speed – and turn them into strong business outcomes that support lasting health.

What you’ll bring

You build trust across organisational and cultural boundaries and create momentum in complex settings. You exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions constructively and keep learning. You will also bring:

• Proven experience leading and developing a high-performing team.

What you’ll do

You will shape transactions from first financial evaluation through to integration, making sure senior decision-makers have the insight they need, when they need it.

Your closest partners will be the CFO, Global Business Development, Finance Operations and teams across the value chain, including R&D. You will contribute directly to decisions made by the CFO, the CEO and the Deal Group, with your expertise trusted to shape outcomes. You will lead and develop a team of 7 colleagues, sustaining an inclusive, high-performing environment where people are supported to grow and do their best work.

The role offers extensive collaboration across Finance, Business Development and R&D, and the chance to help bring AI into how due diligence is done – building new skills for you and your team as the work evolves.

jobs.occupation: Prototype Engineering Specialist (12 months cover position)
jobs.description:
Coordinate complex prototype activities that enable better medical devices.

At Coloplast, we develop products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. In this role, you help our development projects turn product concepts into prototypes: for design iterations, usability studies, clinical trials, and design verification.

You bring structure to technically complex work. You connect engineers, manufacturing specialists and project teams around one plan. Your job is to build the integrated overview, maintain appropriate traceability and make the complete prototype flow work across the relevant stages of product development

Make complex prototype flows work

You coordinate prototype activities in complex development projects. That can mean multiple prototype variants, several manufacturing steps or sites, shifting levels of design maturity, demanding traceability requirements, or a wide stakeholder group.

This is an engineering-based coordination role: you will not be expected to manufacture the prototypes yourself or replace the technical specialists who define the prototype needs and requirements. The technical specialists remain responsible for defining their prototype needs, while the manufacturing teams remain responsible for production execution and manufacturing documentation. You bring these contributions together into one coherent and executable prototype plan. You build plans, spot dependencies and missing information, keep things visible, and push unresolved issues to a decision.

Join a growing engineering capability

You'll join our Test Development Engineering team: Test Development Engineers and Prototype Engineering Specialists, supporting product-development projects across Coloplast.

In this role you’ll have a broad footprint across the whole organization. You'll work closely with Product Development Project Managers, Test Engineers, Mechanical Design Engineers, Clinical and Usability colleagues, Quality Assurance, manufacturing sites, and external partners. You'll also work with the other Prototype Engineering Specialists to build consistent, practical ways of managing prototype activities across the team.

Your key responsibilities are:

• Coordinate complex prototype activities from early project planning through the final samples the project needs.

• Establish and maintain appropriate project-level prototype traceability, including references to the relevant manufacturing documentation.

• Build and maintain one overview of prototype purpose, quantities, variants, maturity, timing, manufacturing flow.

• Align prototype requesters with internal or external manufacturers.

• Challenge unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before they cause delays.

• Coordinate dependencies across components, prototype versions, manufacturing processes, sites, and project activities.

• Keep prototype status, decisions, risks, and open actions visible to everyone who needs them.

• Spot planning, capacity, documentation, and delivery risks early, and work with the right people to fix them.

• Help improve the processes, templates, and working methods for prototype management.

What you bring

Your engineering background lets you challenge weak assumptions, identify gaps, and bring in the right specialist at the right time. You need technical understanding to see how requirements, product variants, materials, manufacturing processes, documentation, and timelines affect each other.

Your real contribution is keeping the complexity manageable, so the team delivers.

We expect that you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, life science, pharmaceutics, or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience coordinating technical activities in product development, manufacturing, engineering, or a similar environment.

• Can turn input from several disciplines into a structured plan people can execute.

• Thrive in a central role, with multiple stakeholder interactions.

• Understand manufacturing flows and how product design, materials, processes, and documentation connect.

• Work confidently with requirements, dependencies, risks, traceability, and shifting priorities.

• Communicate clearly across functions and professional disciplines.

• Take a proactive, practical, accountable approach to commitments and deadlines.

• Are comfortable working in English in an international organization.

Experience in medical devices, life science, or another regulated environment is a plus. So is familiarity with prototype production, design verification, configuration management, quality systems, or coordination across multiple manufacturing sites.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Scott Jonas Hansen, Head of Test Development Engineering, dkschan@coloplast.com

jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

🚚 Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

🚛 Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

• 
Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

• 
Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

• 
Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

• 
Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

🧰 Vi forventer, at du:

• 
Har kørekort C og/eller CE

• 
Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

• 
Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

• 
Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

• 
Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

• 
Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• 
Velholdte lastbiler

• 
Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

• 
Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer

📩 Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:
job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

•

• 
Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

• 
Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

• 
Be reliable, independent, and responsible

Be physically fit and able to handle freight

Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

Well-maintained trucks

Thorough training in routes and procedures

Good colleagues and an informal working environment

Salary based on qualifications and experience
